description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy and correlation of different methods for sentence embeddings, as measured by three metrics: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The vertical axis represents the accuracy and correlation values, ranging from 0 to 0.8, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists five different methods: Single-task baseline, Baseline with Adaptive Dropout, Unsupervised SimCSE, Supervised SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. Each method is represented by a group of three bars, each corresponding to one of the three metrics. The bars are color-coded: Sentiment Accuracy is represented by a light blue bar, STS Correlation by a pink bar, and Paraphrase Accuracy by a light green bar. The values for Sentiment Accuracy and STS Correlation are generally higher than those for Paraphrase Accuracy across all methods. The 2-Tier SimCSE method shows the highest values for all three metrics, particularly for Sentiment Accuracy and STS Correlation, indicating its superior performance in this comparison. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no visual emphasis or annotations on any of the bars.
